## History

Before having a son, Lorenzo White had seven daughters. Following the birth of his boy, an overjoyed Lorenzo was visited by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) while they were canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) residents. Capitalizing on his good mood, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully secured a five-dollar donation from him.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P50](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0050), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_
